name: capturekit-mcp
long_description: Capture websites as PNG, JPEG, WebP or PDF, extract their content, or analyse them with AI.

tools.name: analyze
tools.description: AI Content API analyzes any webpage and returns AI insights summary, value proposition, features, categories, use cases, and optional contact signals.

tools.name: capture
tools.description: Browser-like Screenshot API that captures webpages as PNG/JPEG/WebP or PDF for previews, QA, reporting, monitoring, and archiving no headless setup.

tools.name: content
tools.description: CaptureKit Content API extracts structured webpage data, metadata, links, HTML/Markdown: in one request for SEO, monitoring, indexing and automation.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Infrastructure health for an engine or endpoint over the last hour. Not scoped to your account or tenant. Enabled per account: HTTP 403 means contact support to activate it.

tools.name: usage
tools.description: Retrieve real-time usage statistics and credit balance for your CaptureKit account.

tools.name: website_crawler
tools.description: Website Crawler API fetches raw HTML from any webpage in request mode (no rendering) for fast scraping, audits, monitoring, and link/metadata extraction.
